title: You get what you pay for
text: You get what you pay for. These are attractive looking glasses, don't look like plastic from afar. I was disappointed in the weight and feel of them. Almost like they are less weight than a Solo plastic cup. Not sure if I would ever use these for company, unless we are using them outside. I think buying disposable ones at the supermarket would work just as well.
